description: Search a course by meaning using Canvas's AI search. Read-only. It is a beta Canvas feature that often returns 404; when it does, this tool falls back to a keyword scan. search_course_content is the reliable keyword option.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

filter.description: Optional content types to search. Omit to search all four.
